d64a58cecff270b9.description: Who We Are At BKN301, we build fintech solutions that enable banks, fintechs, and merchants to grow and innovate across emerging markets. We’re a London-based financial technology group, with offices in Milan (Italy), Doha (Qatar), and San Marino, and an international footprint that’s rapidly expanding. Working across multiple countries and markets, we bring together different perspectives, experiences, and expertise. This collaborative approach helps us innovate faster, adapt to change, and build better solutions for our clients. We move fast, think globally, and act as one team — transforming ideas into real, scalable fintech solutions every day. Why Join Us Joining BKN301 means becoming part of a fast-growing international fintech, where technology and people evolve together. Here, every idea counts: you’ll have a tangible impact on strategic growth initiatives, help expand our presence across key markets, and contribute directly to the company’s long-term success. You’ll join us at an exciting stage of growth in Riyadh, helping establish and expand our local presence while building strategic relationships and supporting BKN301’s long-term growth in the Kingdom. You’ll join a company that values each person’s contribution, gives space to experiment, and promotes an open approach to innovation — because our success comes from the people who make it possible. Your Role As a Business Development Manager, you will drive BKN301’s long-term organic growth by identifying new business opportunities, building strategic relationships, and creating a strong pipeline of future revenue opportunities. You will act as the bridge between market opportunities and business execution, helping translate commercial potential into sustainable business growth. A Few Examples of Your Responsibilities Identify and evaluate new market opportunities, customer segments, and growth areas within the fintech ecosystem. Conduct market research and competitor analysis to generate commercial insights and support strategic decision-making. Build and maintain relationships with prospective clients, partners, and key industry stakeholders. Generate qualified opportunities through networking, events, conferences, referrals, and direct outreach activities. Develop tailored commercial proposals aligned with customer needs and business objectives. Support deal structuring, commercial negotiations, and commercial offer preparation. Work closely with internal teams to ensure alignment between market demand, customer expectations, and company priorities. Maintain visibility on pipeline development, commercial activities, and growth initiatives through regular reporting and stakeholder alignment. What We’re Looking For Essential Requirements 5+ years of experience in Business Development, Sales, Partnerships, Account Management, or similar commercial roles. Professional proficiency in Arabic and English. Proven ability to generate opportunities and build commercial pipelines through proactive business development activities. Strong experience developing and managing relationships with enterprise clients and strategic partners. Good understanding of fintech products, financial services, and digital transformation initiatives. Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills. Technical Knowledge Understanding of API architecture, integrations, and digital ecosystems. Knowledge of fintech solutions, including payments, banking technologies, AI/GenAI, and emerging financial services. Familiarity with digital transformation programs and modernization initiatives. Ability to understand customer business challenges and position technology solutions accordingly. Soft Skills That Make a Difference Strategic thinking with a strong commercial mindset. High emotional intelligence and relationship-building capabilities. Strong negotiation and persuasion skills. Resilience, persistence, and a results-oriented approach. Ability to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholders. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Curiosity, adaptability, and a drive for continuous improvement and innovation. What We Offer Competitive, market-aligned compensation. Performance-based incentive structure. Opportunity to play a key role in establishing and growing BKN301’s presence in Riyadh. You’ll be among the first members of our Riyadh team, helping build our local presence, develop strategic relationships, and support long-term growth in the market. The role will initially be remote, with a planned transition to a hybrid working model as our Riyadh operations continue to grow. Dynamic and international environment, built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. Real impact on global fintech transformation projects. Continuous growth and learning opportunities within a fast-evolving and innovative group. Our Culture At BKN301, we believe innovation thrives when different perspectives meet. Working across multiple countries and markets, we value collaboration, mutual respect, and the unique contributions that help us build stronger teams and better products. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a fair and inclusive environment for all.

d66cdaa0f5df1aa8.description: Summary: Lead the strategic direction and integration of placemaking and theming across assigned Qiddiya, translating city ambition into distinctive identities, compelling experiences and deliverable development outcomes. The Director will establish district place visions, retain Qiddiya’s creative authorship and lead thematic development from early planning through design and delivery. Working directly with executive stakeholders, district leadership and multidisciplinary teams, the role will align masterplans, assets and public realm around a coherent place ambition, balancing creative quality with commercial value, operational viability and long-term legacy. Key Responsibilities District Strategy & Thematic Leadership: · Lead place vision, narrative, positioning and thematic strategies across assigned districts, establishing clear priorities and experience objectives. · Direct the development of internal thematic strategies, safeguarding Qiddiya’s authorship while guiding consultant interpretation and design expression. · Embed placemaking within Master Plans and assets designs, ensuring district identity informs spatial planning, asset relationships, public realm and development decisions. · Establish a coherent approach to thematic expression across district, masterplan and asset scales, balancing citywide consistency with local distinctiveness. Planning, Design & Delivery Integration: · Lead the translation of approved strategies into designs, Place Books, experience frameworks and actionable design guidance. · Direct integration across planning, architecture, landscape, public realm, arts, culture and infrastructure interfaces. · Establish design review priorities and guide resolution of issues affecting place quality, thematic integrity and continuity. · Maintain strategic oversight through design development and early delivery, ensuring changes are assessed against approved place objectives. Executive Stakeholder Leadership & Governance · Act as the senior place representative for assigned districts, engaging executive stakeholders and development leaders on strategic direction, priorities and key decisions. · Build alignment across district teams, asset owners and corporate functions, resolving competing requirements and escalating material risks with clear recommendations. · Establish governance, review milestones and decision pathways for place and theming within agreed approval structures. · Present district strategies, investment priorities and delivery implications to leadership, securing alignment on the intended outcomes. Citywide Alignment, Experience & Value: · Lead placemaking contributions to the City Framework Plan aligning district strategies with citywide ambition. · Direct experience planning, activation and meanwhile-use strategies with relevant teams, connecting physical design with programming, marketing and operations. · Ensure cultural relevance, accessibility, thermal comfort and people-first principles inform place outcomes. · Establish performance measures linking placemaking to experience quality, commercial objectives, operational sustainability and long-term value. Resources, Procurement & Team Leadership · Lead place-related scopes, consultant appointments and procurement inputs, defining deliverables, responsibilities and quality expectations. · Manage assigned budgets, resources and forecasts, recommending proportionate in-house and consultant delivery models. · Lead multidisciplinary teams and consultants, developing internal capability and a culture of creative ownership, collaboration and delivery accountability. · 18–20 years of relevant professional experience in placemaking, thematic development, urban design or masterplanning, including substantial senior leadership responsibility. · Degree in urban design, architecture, landscape architecture, planning or a related discipline. · Demonstrated leadership of complex mixed-use, cultural, entertainment or destination districts from strategic vision through design and delivery. · Proven ability to engage executive stakeholders, lead multidisciplinary teams and translate creative ambition into commercially and operationally viable outcomes. · Strong expertise in district identity, thematic frameworks, public realm, experience planning, governance, procurement and budget management. · Excellent strategic judgment, negotiation and executive communication skills, with sensitivity to Saudi cultural context.

d6c831cfb5013835.description: Department: Compliance Employment Type: Full Time Location: KSA Reporting To: Mansour Alshehri Description As the Compliance Officer, you will support the effective implementation and ongoing management of the organization's compliance framework to ensure adherence to SAMA regulatory requirements, applicable laws, and internal policies. You will independently perform compliance monitoring, regulatory analysis, risk assessments, regulatory obligations tracking, and compliance reviews, while providing day-to-day advisory support to business functions. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation and ongoing management of the organization's compliance framework in line with SAMA regulations and applicable regulatory requirements. Monitor SAMA circulars, regulatory updates, guidance, and relevant industry developments and assess their impact on the organization's activities. Conduct regulatory research and analysis and translate applicable requirements into practical compliance actions and internal requirements. Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, standards, and controls. Perform compliance monitoring and testing activities to assess adherence to regulatory requirements, policies, procedures, and established controls. Conduct compliance risk assessments and identify potential regulatory risks, control gaps, and areas requiring remediation. Maintain regulatory obligations trackers and monitor the implementation and completion of SAMA regulatory requirements across relevant business functions. Provide day-to-day compliance advisory support to business teams on SAMA regulatory requirements, policies, processes, and operational activities. Review products, services, processes, partnerships, and business initiatives to identify applicable compliance requirements and potential regulatory risks. Support the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory reports and other required regulatory communications. Conduct compliance reviews and assessments relating to potential regulatory breaches, policy violations, and control weaknesses. Document compliance findings, recommendations, and remediation actions and monitor progress against agreed timelines. Support investigations into potential compliance breaches and regulatory issues, escalating material or complex matters to the Compliance Manager. Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent compliance reviews by preparing documentation, coordinating responses, and tracking remediation activities. Maintain accurate and up-to-date compliance registers, records, trackers, and supporting documentation. Prepare compliance reports, monitoring results, regulatory updates, risk assessments, and other materials for management review. Support the development and delivery of compliance training and awareness activities. Work closely with Risk, Legal, Internal Audit, Operations, Information Security, and business teams to strengthen compliance controls and address regulatory requirements. Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, controls, monitoring activities, and reporting. Escalate material compliance risks, breaches, control deficiencies, and regulatory concerns to the Compliance Lead in a timely manner. Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related discipline. At least 3 years of experience in Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, Governance, Audit, or a related function, preferably within banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment. Good working knowledge of SAMA regulatory requirements and applicable Saudi financial services regulations. Good understanding of compliance frameworks, SAMA regulatory obligations, compliance monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and internal controls. Experience conducting compliance monitoring, regulatory research, compliance reviews, risk assessments, or related compliance activities. Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining compliance policies, procedures, and controls. Ability to interpret SAMA regulatory requirements and translate them into practical business requirements and compliance actions. Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, compliance reviews, investigations, and remediation activities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify regulatory risks and recommend appropriate actions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with business and control functions. Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate compliance documentation and records. Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently on assigned compliance activities in a fast-paced regulated environment. High level of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound regulatory judgment. Compliance certification such as CAMS, CCO, or an equivalent certification is preferred. Additional certifications in risk management, governance, financial crime, or regulatory compliance are considered an advantage. Benefits We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees. Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone. You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the region We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process. We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

d611e7b850f11bb6.description: Job description Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarters in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also, Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell You will construct agentic AI architecture, leveraging large language models to orchestrate planning, execution, and tool interactions with minimal supervision. Working within a compact engineering team, you will build the core foundational infrastructure, spanning microservices, integration protocols, state management, tracing, and eval harnesses, ensuring systems are production-ready, reliable, and scalable. This hands-on backend software engineering position focuses primarily on coding, testing, and system diagnostics. While prompt design is incorporated into the workflow, complex architectural challenges reside within the underlying infrastructure. We welcome applicants across diverse seniority levels. Given that production-grade agentic engineering remains an emerging discipline, candidates bring varied expertise; candidate capability determines final level placement. Opportunities exist for early-career developers through veteran software architects. Engineering excellence remains mandatory across all levels. Junior engineers pair directly with senior mentors to own production components within three months, while senior engineers drive technical standards and architectural vision. What You Will Do ❓ Architect and maintain agent infrastructure, including orchestration logic, session handling, state management, and reliable backend service interfaces. Design robust tool integrations and MCP servers featuring precise boundary definitions and comprehensive error recovery handlers. Implement end-to-end tracing and observability for model calls, retrieval, and tool executions adhering to OpenTelemetry GenAI standards. Construct evaluation suites, benchmarks, and regression tests to validate model iterations and systematically capture production edge cases. Perform deep-dive root cause analysis on runtime failures, loops, context degradation, or hallucinated outputs to strengthen system resiliency. Enforce runtime guardrails, cost thresholds, RBAC permissions, output validation schemas, and human-in-the-loop validation triggers. Monitor industry advancements, emerging AI research, and architectural patterns, sharing technical insights across the engineering organization. What Are We Looking For❓ Essential Deep software engineering expertise in a modern programming language, prioritizing algorithmic depth over superficial multi-language breadth. Strong computer science foundations in data structures, algorithms, memory allocation, and concurrent execution patterns. Practical experience with backend infrastructure: REST/gRPC APIs, relational/non-relational databases, caching tiers, message queues, and distributed systems resilience. Proficiency with Git, automated testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing clean, maintainable software. Comprehensive mental model of LLM mechanics: context window constraints, tokenization, function calling protocols, non-deterministic behaviors, and hallucination management. Demonstrated history of delivering full-lifecycle technical projects across production environments, academic work, open source, or side initiatives. Methodical debugging skills with the ability to articulate systematic troubleshooting methodologies. Strong technical documentation and written communication skills to articulate complex distributed system behaviors. Expectations by Seniority Level Core requirements apply universally, with ownership and operational scale adjusting based on candidate seniority. Early Career: Focuses on technical foundations, algorithmic problem-solving, and curiosity. Prior agentic experience is not required; mentorship is provided to expand scope over well-defined modules. Mid-Level: Owns sub-systems end-to-end, translates ambiguous requirements into robust architecture, and demonstrates a proven track record of shipping and maintaining production services. Senior Level: Drives strategic architectural direction, possesses hands-on experience scaling non-deterministic systems, elevates team-wide engineering practices, and actively challenges technical assumptions. Nice to Have Hands-on experience developing application prototypes integrated with LLM APIs. Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or custom tool integrations. Understanding of vector database indexing, embedding generation, and retrieval pipelines (RAG). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), telemetry, or IaC tooling. Knowledge of GenAI security paradigms, prompt injection mitigation, and threat modeling. Active open-source contributions or community engagement. Out of Scope Extensive experience with specific agent frameworks, given the nascent nature of the ecosystem. Academic AI research background, specialized ML degrees, or mathematical derivation of backpropagation. Deep expertise in base model training or fine-tuning workflows. Flawless portfolio presentations; emphasis is placed on technical depth and problem-solving reasoning. Strictly conventional career trajectories; non-traditional and self-taught engineering backgrounds are evaluated equally. Technical Standards & Architecture Our engineering environment adheres to industry standards and operational frameworks, with continuous learning embedded into the engineering onboarding process. Model Context Protocol (MCP): Open standard managed via the Linux Foundation for integrating models with tool services and data stores. OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions: Standardized instrumentation schemas for tracking model execution traces, step transitions, and tool invocations. OWASP GenAI & Agentic Security Guidelines: Threat modeling standards emphasizing containment strategies, least-privilege tooling, strict input sanitization, and authorization gates for critical actions. Eval-Driven Development: Mandatory evaluation validation prior to shipping behavioral changes, relying on internal domain-specific test harnesses rather than external benchmark metrics. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups. We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company. Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

Jaberco emphasizes precision in execution and adherence to the highest safety standards, offering professionals a structured and performance-driven work environment. d62720f3bfa2d154.description: About the Role Virtucruit is conducting a confidential search for a Chief Digital and eCommerce Officer for a large Saudi business. Build data, personalization, and segmentation engines to translate customer insights into measurable commercial impact. d67ca5513b738bb5.description: المسمى الوظيفي أخصائي كتابة محتوى إبداعي وحسابات التواصل الاجتماعي الهدف من الوظيفة صناعة وكتابة المحتوى الإبداعي للمؤسسة وإدارة حساباتها على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، بما يعزز حضور العلامة التجارية، ويرفع مستوى التفاعل مع الجمهور، ويضمن اتساق الرسائل والمحتوى مع الهوية والأهداف التسويقية والاتصالية للمؤسسة. المهام والمسؤوليات إعداد وكتابة المحتوى الإبداعي لمنصات التواصل الاجتماعي والمواقع والمنصات الرقمية. ابتكار وتطوير الأفكار الإبداعية للحملات والمبادرات والمناسبات بما يتناسب مع هوية العلامة التجارية وأهدافها. إدارة وتشغيل حسابات التواصل الاجتماعي، بما يشمل إعداد المحتوى وجدولته ونشره ومتابعة التفاعل. إعداد خطط وجداول المحتوى الأسبوعية والشهرية وفق الأهداف التسويقية والاتصالية. كتابة النصوص الترويجية، والمنشورات، والعناوين، والنصوص القصيرة للفيديوهات والقصص الرقمية. متابعة التوجهات الحديثة في صناعة المحتوى ومنصات التواصل الاجتماعي وتوظيفها بما يخدم العلامة التجارية. التنسيق مع فرق التصميم والتصوير والإنتاج لضمان تحويل الأفكار والمحتوى إلى مواد بصرية متكاملة. متابعة تعليقات واستفسارات الجمهور والتفاعل معها وفق أسلوب وهوية المؤسسة. رصد أداء الحسابات وتحليل مؤشرات التفاعل والوصول والنمو، وإعداد التقارير والتوصيات التطويرية. المساهمة في إدارة الحملات الرقمية والإعلانية وصياغة الرسائل والمحتوى الخاص بها. ضمان الالتزام بنبرة وهوية العلامة التجارية في جميع المواد والمحتويات المنشورة. متابعة المحتوى المنشور ورصد الملاحظات أو الأزمات الرقمية والتعامل معها بالتنسيق مع الإدارة المختصة. البحث المستمر عن الموضوعات والأفكار ذات الصلة باهتمامات الجمهور وتحويلها إلى محتوى قابل للنشر. المساهمة في بناء مجتمع رقمي متفاعل حول العلامة التجارية وتعزيز صورتها وحضورها لدى الجمهور. متابعة أفضل الممارسات في مجال صناعة المحتوى وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي، ومقارنة أداء المؤسسة بالممارسات والمعايير المتبعة لدى المؤسسات الرائدة، وتحديد فرص التحسين والتطوير. اقتراح مبادرات وأفكار جديدة لتطوير المحتوى وتعزيز الحضور الرقمي ورفع مستوى التفاعل مع الجمهور. المؤهلات والمهارات درجة البكالوريوس أو الدبلوم في الإعلام، العلاقات العامة، التسويق، الاتصال، اللغة العربية أو أي تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة في كتابة المحتوى الإبداعي وإدارة منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. معرفة جيدة بخصائص ومتطلبات منصات التواصل الاجتماعي المختلفة. مهارات قوية في البحث، وتوليد الأفكار، وصناعة المحتوى. قدرة عالية على الكتابة وصياغة الرسائل بأسلوب إبداعي وجذاب. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع المصممين والمصورين وفرق الإنتاج. الإلمام بأدوات إدارة وجدولة المحتوى وتحليل أداء الحسابات. القدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة والالتزام بالمواعيد والجداول الزمنية. معرفة جيدة بالاتجاهات الرقمية الحديثة وسلوك الجمهور على منصات التواصل الاجتماعي. مهارات جيدة في التحليل وقراءة مؤشرات الأداء واستخلاص التوصيات.

d61a7f2b7c608a04.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الاشغال الميسرة التجارية عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الأحساء، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل، ويكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال وإعداد برامج الصيانة. الغرض من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان كفاءة وسلامة الأنظمة الكهربائية في المشاريع المختلفة. يشمل ذلك إعداد التصاميم الفنية، وتحديد مسارات شبكات النقل والتوزيع، وتشغيل المعدات، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ووضع خطط الإصلاح والصيانة لضمان استمرارية العمليات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية ومتابعة التنفيذ. إعداد مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بحسب متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية وفقاً لتوصيات الشركة الصانعة والتعليمات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الدراسات والتحاليل، وعرضها ومناقشتها. حفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية. مهارات في تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق عمل في بيئة ديناميكية تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الأحساء بالمنطقة الشرقية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

d6e9bd0526b2240a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التحسين العالمية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة منها، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني وتعديلها. معرفة بمبادئ ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المعماري في مدينة جدة ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة، في بيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على مشاريع الإنشاءات والتصميم المعماري. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتيح للمرشح فرصة للاندماج الكامل في مشاريع الشركة والمساهمة في تحقيق أهدافها. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

d6fcba9719600bc5.description: About Mace Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to enhance projects and redefine ambition. The company's values guide its consultancy approach and define the individuals sought to join its team. The Project and Role Overview This full-time role is for a Senior Project Manager, Infrastructure Specialist, based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The position involves leading a landmark program focused on delivering premium buildings and supporting infrastructure for a prestigious private estate. This project includes a diverse portfolio of high-value developments, requiring high standards of design, planning, and execution. The Senior Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, delivery assurance, and stakeholder integration of complex infrastructure projects, applying senior project management discipline and technical infrastructure insight to ensure outcomes are achieved safely, on time, within budget, and to required quality standards. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end infrastructure project delivery, from strategy, planning, and mobilisation through design coordination, procurement, construction, commissioning, handover, and closeout. Establish robust project governance, delivery controls, baseline schedules, cost controls, risk management, issue resolution, and reporting rhythms aligned with programme requirements. Integrate multidisciplinary technical inputs across civil, utilities, transport, buildings, public realm, systems, interfaces, and enabling works to support coordinated delivery. Manage senior stakeholders, authorities, consultants, and contractors to drive decisions, remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain alignment on scope, quality, safety, commercial, and schedule objectives. Provide strategic advice to programme leadership on constructability, sequencing, procurement strategy, delivery risks, interface constraints, change impacts, and recovery options. Champion HSE, quality, sustainability, compliance, and assurance expectations across the project lifecycle. Approve project execution plans, mobilisation plans, delivery strategies, interface plans, and stakeholder engagement plans. Develop integrated schedules, lookahead plans, progress reports, dashboards, risk and issue registers, decision logs, and escalation papers. Prepare package delivery plans, procurement and tender inputs, technical evaluations, change impact assessments, and recovery/action plans. Compile governance meeting packs, executive reporting, assurance responses, lessons learned, and closeout documentation. Required Qualifications and Experience A Saudi National. Over 10 years of experience in project management, specifically within infrastructure projects. Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects from inception to completion. Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement. Company Values Mace operates on core values that guide its operations and team interactions: Safety first - Going home safe and well: Fostering a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, with an emphasis on well-being. Client focus - Deliver on our promise: Taking ownership of deliverables and strategic outcomes, building long-term client relationships. Integrity - Always do the right thing: Influencing positive industry outcomes while adhering to compliance obligations. Create opportunity - For our people to excel: Promoting a continuous improvement culture to inspire team development. Application Information Mace is an inclusive employer and encourages applications from a diverse range of candidates. Applicants who may not meet all criteria are still encouraged to apply, as they may be suitable for this or other roles within the organisation.

d6092f95425b5f6c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مدير أشغال ومرافق عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تخطيط وتوجيه وتنسيق أنشطة إدارة المرافق في المنشأة، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية الحالية والمستقبلية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. يهدف الدور إلى ضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة وفعالية، مع الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع الخطط والسياسات والاستراتيجيات الإدارية العامة لمرافق الشركة، والإشراف على تنفيذها. ضمان الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، والإشراف على تطبيقها. مباشرة الأنشطة اليومية للمرافق، بما في ذلك المواقع المادية، والتصاميم، والأثاث. تخطيط الجداول الزمنية لأعمال الصيانة والتنظيف للمرافق. مباشرة أنشطة الصيانة وتنسيق عمليات التصليح لتقليل مدة التوقف عن العمل. تخطيط أعمال الإنشاء والملحقات الجديدة، وإعداد ومراجعة واعتماد العقود المتعلقة بالبناء. إدارة الفريق اختيار الموظفين وتدريبهم والإشراف عليهم. مراقبة أداء وسلوك الموظفين وتقييمهم مقارنةً بالأهداف المحددة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال إدارة الأشغال والمرافق العامة. فهم عميق لعمليات الصيانة والتنظيف وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية. القدرة على وضع الخطط والاستراتيجيات وتنفيذها بفعالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل مدير الأشغال والمرافق العامة ضمن فريق متخصص، ويتحمل مسؤولية مباشرة عن إدارة جميع جوانب المرافق لضمان بيئة عمل آمنة ومنظمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. نحن نبحث عن محترف ملتزم وقادر على قيادة فريق إدارة المرافق وتحقيق الأهداف التشغيلية للشركة.

d60b1c79b41f27ef.description: About the Role Misk Schools is seeking a Homeroom Teacher for its Junior School in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position focuses on the education of students from KG1 to Grade 3 (ages 3 to 9), with a primary responsibility for achieving high standards in student work and conduct. The role involves encouraging student participation in classroom and school activities while prioritizing the safeguarding and well-being of all students. Key Responsibilities Deliver high-quality teaching and learning aligned with the Misk curriculum and local requirements. Establish a safe and stimulating learning environment for students. Plan, prepare, and deliver schemes of work, provide feedback, and teach in accordance with school and departmental procedures. Maintain records of student progress, including all statutory documents, and produce reports and grades as per the school calendar. Conduct termly interviews with parents to discuss student performance and progress. Ensure the good order and safety of students during registration, record attendance, and oversee general welfare, reporting individual needs via the information management system. Monitor and record student rewards and sanctions. Employ a variety of motivating and stimulating approaches to student learning, differentiate instruction based on student needs, and evaluate/modify planning as necessary. Provide pastoral support and carry out duties of care as a homeroom or form tutor, including during non-class times. Understand and implement all welfare and safeguarding policies, promoting and safeguarding the welfare of all pupils. Liaise with other staff, such as the school nurse and educational counselors, as required. Follow regulations for attendance registers and effectively implement emergency and evacuation procedures. Conduct standardized or other tests when required and document student performance. Attend and participate in weekly staff meetings, team planning meetings, and all training days. Supervise students during morning parade, dismissal, playtimes, lunchtimes, and assemblies when required. Liaise with colleagues to ensure satisfactory transfers of children within and between schools. Promote subjects within the school and provide co-curricular opportunities and additional activities outside the classroom. Identify the needs of individuals and groups within the class and liaise with the learning support team. Utilize school-approved digital technology tools and liaise with the cultural committee to ensure culturally acceptable lesson materials. Ensure all students meet the school's progress and attainment targets. Teach no more than 20 lessons per week as directed by the school principal. Support with cover and duty as needed by the principal, including assemblies and co-curricular/enrichment activities. Undertake any other reasonable requests by the principal or line manager. Safeguarding Responsibilities The Homeroom Teacher is required to safeguard and promote the welfare of children and young people, adhering to the school's safeguarding policies and staff code of conduct. This role involves direct support to the designated safeguarding lead to ensure the safety and well-being of all students at the school as a priority. Qualifications and Experience Experience required: 0-1 years. A working knowledge of relevant curricula and educational documents. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the Junior School (KG1 - Grade 3) at Misk Schools. The role involves collaboration with colleagues and adherence to school policies and procedures.

d6229e74f59dcaf8.description: About the Role Sheraton Hotels & Resorts is seeking a Clerk Accounts Payable to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves ensuring the accuracy of financial data, maintaining organized records, and supporting various accounting functions in accordance with established policies and procedures. Organize, secure, and update all financial files, folders, cash, and cash equivalents according to company policies. Record, store, access, and analyze computerized financial information. Classify, code, and summarize numerical and financial data to maintain financial records using journals, ledgers, and computers. Perform specified period-end closing procedures and generate reports. Periodically verify cash drawers in line with standard operating procedures. Maintain, distribute, and record petty cash, cash drawers, and contracts. d66be90297323d8f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رائدة في المنطقة الشرقية عن موظف مبيعات وتسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية، بالإضافة إلى الترويج لمنتجات وخدمات الشركة وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. يشمل النطاق الجغرافي للدور مدن الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، الهفوف، بقيق، راس تنورة، الخفجي، قرية العليا، النعيرية، صفوى، القطيف، سيهات، تاروت، الجش، عنك، دارين، أم الحمام، جواثا، المبرز، العمران، والجفر. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مسؤولية رئيسية في تنمية الأعمال من خلال استقطاب العملاء الجدد وبناء علاقات قوية معهم. كما يساهم في تنفيذ الأنشطة التسويقية التي تدعم نمو الشركة وتوسع قاعدة عملائها، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. المهام والمسؤوليات تطوير مبيعات B2B في مجال خدمات الموارد البشرية. استقطاب العملاء من قطاع الأعمال وبناء علاقات مهنية مستدامة معهم. الترويج لخدمات الشركة بفعالية وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة. متابعة فرص البيع المحتملة حتى إتمام التعاقد بنجاح. المساهمة في تنمية قاعدة العملاء وتوسيع نطاق الأعمال. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال المبيعات والتسويق. القدرة على استقطاب العملاء وتطوير العلاقات المهنية. مهارات قوية في التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في المنطقة الشرقية بالمملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق ديناميكي يهدف إلى تحقيق أهداف المبيعات وتوسيع نطاق أعمال الشركة في قطاع خدمات الموارد البشرية. معلومات إضافية اسم الشركة محجوب من قبل صاحب العمل، وسيتم الكشف عنه للمرشحين المؤهلين. الراتب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

d68590b97d96d32b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض، وتحديداً في الارطاوية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام الرئيسية يتضمن الدور مجموعة من المهام الهندسية الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات الميكانيكية بكفاءة وفعالية، وتشمل: إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. تطوير خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. إعداد برامج تشغيل المعدات وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية وفقاً لتعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة إجراءات تنفيذها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وعرضها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. فهم جيد لبرامج تشغيل وصيانة المعدات الميكانيكية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الميكانيكي ضمن فريق شركه تبراك نجد للمقاولات في مدينة الرياض، وتحديداً في منطقة الارطاوية. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب الالتزام بمهام المشروع ومواعيده. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.
